rid.en: Unpack here means explain. Sonja explains that when our skin feels itchy, we scratch it, and that helps to get rid of parasites and other harmful things on our skin.

risk.en: A risk not worth taking. But then, in the past couple of years, something has changed.
risk.zh: 这是一场不值得冒的险。但在过去几年里，情况发生了一些变化。

risk.en: This was not luxurious food. Hunger and starvation were actually serious risks for people across Britain, across Europe at the time.
risk.zh: 这不是奢侈的食物。在当时，饥饿和饥荒实际上是全英国、全欧洲人们面临的严重风险。
